llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Shanghai Library seat reservation helper that uses local auth profiles to list, book, and cancel reservations at the user's direction.

dimensions.detail: Network use is scoped to Shanghai Library domains and npm/Playwright installation needs; file access is limited to selected auth profile files under the default config path or user-specified paths.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation requests Node.js and Playwright from standard tooling; no remote payload execution, tool replacement, or hidden installer behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It performs account-affecting actions including booking and cancellation, but those actions are documented and require explicit CLI subcommands and parameters such as a reservation ID.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill stores accessToken, sign, and timestamp in local profile JSON files with chmod 600, which is sensitive but disclosed and necessary for the stated automation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The SKILL, README, scripts, and API reference align around Shanghai Library East Branch 3F seat availability, booking, listing, cancellation, and browser-assisted auth capture.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable letting the skill store Shanghai Library auth tokens locally and use them to view, create, and cancel seat reservations. Keep the profile files private and review cancel commands carefully because they modify existing reservations.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: Cancellation is a real state-changing capability, but it is disclosed in the feature list, README, command reference, and API mapping, and it requires an explicit cancel command with a reservation ID.
[AE1] expected: The referenced scripts/book_seat.js artifact was present and inspected; the automatic login refresh behavior matched the documented profile-auth workflow rather than analysis evasion.
